name: hijack-tech-assignment
description: Hijack Poker Technical Assignment - Serverless Infrastructure

scripts.infra:up: docker run -d --rm --name hp-redis -p 6379:6379 redis:7-alpine && docker run -d --rm --name hp-pg -p 5432:5432 -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=dev -e POSTGRES_DB=hijack postgres:16-alpine
scripts.dev: concurrently -n worker,gateway,coach,web -c blue,green,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w apps/worker" "npm run dev -w apps/gateway" "npm run dev -w apps/coach" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
